649.name: hep_screening_doctor
649.title: Screening Questions For Coordinator/Study Doctor

12.0.field_title: Does the patient have generalized seizures (absence, myoclonus or generalized tonic-clonic convulsions) based on seizure semiology?

12.2.field_title: Has the patient had at least one seizure of any type above in the past 6 months?

12.4.field_title: Has the patient had an EEG done?

12.6.field_title: If YES, does the EEG show at least one of the following:
12.6.field_constraint_data:
GTCSs alone accompanied by generalized spike-wave consistent with IGE per adjudication review|GTCSs with a history of absence and/or myoclonus, accompanied by generalized spike/wave consistent with IGE per adjudication review|GTCSs associated with a history of absence and/or myoclonus, not accompanied by generalized spike-wave consistent with IGE per adjudication review|A Clear history of absence and/or myoclonus, accompanied by generalized spike-wave consistent with IGE per adjudication review
>is_shown_fg=$(eeg)=='true'

12.7.field_title: Has the patient had an MRI done?

12.11.field_title: Does the patient have a progressive neurological disorder?
12.11.field_description: (e.g., brain tumor, Alzheimer's disease, progressive myoclonic epilepsy, etc.)

12.13.field_title: Does the patient have epileptic or development encephalopathy?

12.15.field_title: Does the patient have any major medical comorbidities?
12.15.field_description: (e.g. HIV, kidney failure requiring dialysis, metastatic cancer, significant kidney or liver disease)

12.17.field_title: Does the patient have Autism Spectrum Disorder?

12.19.field_title: Has the patient been diagnosed with chronic drug or alcohol abuse within the last 2 years?

12.20.field_title: If yes, clarify if abuse interferes with activities of daily living

12.23.field_title: Does the patient have a history of previous or current significant psychiatric disorder that would interfere with study requirements?

649.description: Subject may not be eligible if the response is “No” to Q8 and Q9 or  “Yes” to any of Q12 – Q17.
